classification.difficultyReason: Calculate the target triangle and square-board areas, then use their ratio under the stated uniform model.

content.prompt:
A square dartboard of side $6\text{ cm}$ is shown. Juna throws a dart, and it hits the board. Assume it is equally likely to land anywhere on the board.
What is the probability of it landing in the triangular area?

spec.sourceRegion: Question 30, diagram below the stem at the left.
spec.description: Square board with a triangle sharing its bottom edge. The centred apex is 4 cm above the 6 cm base. A perpendicular altitude is drawn, with 4 cm to its left and 6 cm below the base. Only the target triangle has light-orange fill.

mathematics.precision: Approved idealised exact integer givens; retain the printed 4 cm and 6 cm without rounding.

spec.answerVisibility: Question diagram contains only supplied measurements and the target region. Areas and probability remain in answer fields.
